summary: Completed backend-first verification for read-path optimization candidate using disposable loopback Mongo and preview smoke. Functional parity and failure contracts passed, but isolated cold-path benchmarks show the new pointer+lookup cohort pipeline is materially slower than the old compact pipeline for both 256B and 4KiB payload fixtures.

critical.endpoint: core cohort read path used by /api/my-products, /api/price-intel/dashboard, /api/price-intel/store-ranking, /api/market-share/overview, /api/insights/*
critical.issue: HIGH regression risk in isolated benchmark: new pointer+lookup cohort pipeline median ~822-825ms vs old compact ~417-419ms (about 2x slower) with same docs/keys examined (101952/101953).

action_items: Re-evaluate acceptance of current late-materialization cohort implementation for production rollout due to isolated cold regression (~2x).
Investigate reducing winner lookup amplification/getMore cost in new pipeline (e.g., narrowed winner fetch strategy) before claiming read-path speed fix.
Keep current bounded 503 contract behavior (price_query_timeout / price_source_changed) as-is; it validated correctly under injected timeout/network failures.
Run follow-up benchmark on a fixture that includes true production-like index/cardinality skew and compare old/new p95 before merge decision.
critical_code_review_comments: No evidence of silent row loss in tested paths: parity checks for old/new cohort key sets and store-latest key sets passed on disposable fixture.
Observed index family in iter51 fixture matches requested actual names (_id_, crawled_at_1, sku_1_crawled_at_-1, product_id_1, store_id_1_crawled_at_-1); no extra 'make it fast' index was introduced.
Ranking 7d-bounded path matched old full-history+exclusion semantics on tested fixture (store_id -> products/in_stock_pct/rank parity).
MY_PRODUCTS baseline_pre_fix artifact was preserved and not overwritten.

success_rate.backend: 100% test pass rate (19/19), but performance objective NOT met for new cohort path in isolated benchmarks
success_rate.frontend: N/A (backend-first run; only load/smoke evidence captured)

seed_data_creation: Created disposable UUID loopback Mongo fixtures only. Largest iter51 fixture: 2832 own products, 101953 snapshots, payload variants 256B and 4KiB. All disposable DBs dropped post-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested heavy preview smoke GETs in iter51 returned 200 on external URL (/api/stores, /api/insights/leaderboard, /api/price-intel/store-ranking, /api/market-share/overview, /api/insights/top-sellers, /api/my-products days=14/30). Failure injections in iter51 are MOCKED and validated retryable 503 behavior. Main open concern is performance regression of new pointer cohort read path under isolated cold benchmark.
rca of the issue: RCA (performance): in isolated fixtures using requested index family, the pointer pipeline adds per-winner lookup materialization overhead and significantly higher aggregate/getMore duration despite same docs/keys examined. Measured medians: old compact ~417-419ms vs new pointer ~822-825ms (both 256B and 4KiB payload datasets). Functional behavior (parity, failure contracts, no partial-empty success) validated; speed claim did not. Mitigation: treat as potential reject/revise for performance until improved p95 on representative load.
